relationships.subject: CGRP monoclonal antibodies
relationships.evidence_quote: Patient experiences of using subcutaneous CGRP mAbs in Finland showed improvements in several migraine-related factors, supporting the potential for CGRP mAbs to improve the quality of life of adults with migraine.

relationships.subject: galcanezumab
relationships.evidence_quote: Similar findings were observed for people receiving galcanezumab.

key_findings: In 383 Finnish CGRP mAb users, monthly migraine days >=12 fell from 73.6% to 9.0% and pain intensity median from 8 to 6.
Galcanezumab users (20.4%) had more prior CGRP mAb switches.
